title: Multiplayer is now open to all players
text: Multiplayer is live for everyone in Truckers of Europe 3. Update your game, create a room, and invite your friends. Finish jobs together, explore the roads, and see trucks, trailers, interiors, and characters in every room. Join us on Discord to plan the first Apex Transporte convoy.

title: Truckers of Europe 3 Update 0.9.8 is live on Google Play
text: Update 0.9.8 is rolling out on the Google Play Store. It takes time to reach all players, so stay patient if you do not see it yet. The App Store release comes soon. You get multiplayer rooms, the new Ivora truck, a new character system, driver hiring, a redesigned world map, improved traffic AI (work in progress), dynamic navigation between any two cities, animated road events, and performance and stability fixes. Update your game today and try multiplayer with your crew. Source: Wanda Software Team.

title: Multiplayer PRO arrives in Truckers of Europe 3
text: Multiplayer PRO is a paid plan with almost no daily limits. Monthly costs US$1.17. Yearly costs US$10.51 with three months free, a 25 percent saving. PRO gives you unlimited rooms at once, unlimited autopilot and unlimited truck changes. You create 10 rooms per day, host 20 players per room and open five mini watch windows. Your income bonus rises from x1 to x1.25 and your server priority moves from medium to high.

title: Truckers of Europe 3: big update and multiplayer on the way
text: Wanda Software says multiplayer development is complete and the public release is almost ready. The next update adds the IVECO S-Way truck, driver hiring and job management, a new world map with navigation between any two cities, character customization, and multiplayer rooms to play and take jobs with friends. After it come a new DAF truck, a Volvo interior update, and the map expansion.

title: Multiplayer convoys are coming
text: Multiplayer is still in testing. We will post the first convoy dates here and on Discord as soon as testing ends.

title: The new Apex Transporte site is live
text: Check the job log, the leaderboard, the gallery and the promotion ladder. Numbers update on their own.
